Bill.BriefDescription: Allowing operating agency members to purchase energy from the agency.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to joint operating agencies; and adding a newsection to chapter 43.52 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 43.52 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: A city or district that is a member of an operating agency maycontract to buy from the operating agency electric power and energyrequired for its present or future requirements including the capacityand output of one or more specified projects. The contract may providethat the city or district must make the payments required by thecontract whether or not a project is completed, operable, or operatingnotwithstanding the suspension, interruption, interference, reduction,or curtailment of the output of a project or the power and energycontracted for. The contract may also provide that payments under thecontract are not subject to reduction, whether by offset or otherwise,and shall not be conditioned upon the performance or nonperformance of p. 1 HB 1854the operating agency or another member of the operating agency underthe contract or other instrument.
